proposed_relationship: Fusing heat-stable Argonautes with zinc-finger nucleases or TALENs could create a versatile and efficient genome editing tool.
mechanism: The mechanism involves combining the ability of prokaryotic Argonaute proteins to use small DNA guides for targeted cleavage with the specificity of zinc-finger nucleases or TALENs for cutting specific genomic loci, potentially leveraging the heat stability of thermophilic bacteria-derived Argonautes to enhance the robustness of the editing tool across various conditions.
constraint_released: This fusion releases the constraint of requiring extensive protein engineering for each new genomic target by utilizing the guide-based system of Argonautes.
